title: UI skin
description: ui/skins/<id>/skin.yaml of any pack: the look of every screen of the UI, which the player picks with the ui_skin setting. A skin only changes the look: the documents keep their element ids, scripts and commands (docs/architecture/ui.md).

assetId.description: An asset id: the path without its extension.

id.description: The skin's id: the name of its folder under ui/skins/.

name.description: The text key of the name the menus show, such as ui_skin.<id> for the game pack's skins; a mod keeps its keys in a localization file of its own.

extends.description: The id of a skin this one adds to: its sheets apply first, so this skin's rules win.

theme.description: RCSS style sheets for every document, before each screen's styles.

screens.description: The look of each screen, by the name the game loads its document under (hud, main_menu, pause_menu, partner_menu, battle).

styles.description: RCSS style sheets for the screen, in order.

document.description: An RML document that replaces the screen's own: the same element ids and scripts, laid out another way.

sprite_sheets.description: Sprite sheets the style sheets use (RCSS @spritesheet), measured in the pixels of the original image.

name.description: The sprite sheet's name in RCSS.

image.description: The image's asset id; any file type the packs provide (PNG, KTX2).

palette.description: A palette of the indexed image's metadata (<image>_meta.yaml) to draw it with.

original_size.description: The image's size in original pixels, [width, height]; a larger image is an upscaled copy and the sprites grow with it.

dp_per_pixel.description: How many dp an original pixel covers (3 draws the original's 240 lines over the UI's 720 dp).

sprites.description: Each sprite's rectangle in original pixels: [x, y, width, height].
